t: A free mobile app for building games with visual blocks on a phone.
steps: Install Pocket Code from Google Play or the App Store.
Ask IT to approve the app on school devices.
Try a sample program on the phone.
Build a small game with a few blocks.
Decide whether students will share to the community site. An account is presumably needed but unverified.
Check privacy details with IT before students share programs.
Test on a Chromebook only after checking Android app support.
